tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Find published ecommerce tools by text, seller task, platform, pricing type and delivery kind. Filters combine with AND. Returns up to 20 concise matches with EcomPick source links and last checked dates. Any-store tools are included for a platform but are not implied to have native integrations.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one published tool by exact slug: tagline, task, platform support, pricing label and official pricing link, website, alternatives, EcomPick source and last checked date. Does not invent prices or ratings.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Get editorially linked published alternatives to a tool. Returns an empty list when none are documented; does not guess substitutes.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two or three distinct published tools by pricing label, official pricing page, platforms, any-store support and delivery kind. Includes sources and last checked dates; no scores or invented prices.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List seller task IDs and names for the task filter, with published tool counts, EcomPick links and the oldest available last checked date among their tools.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List commerce platform IDs and names for the platform filter. Counts are explicit platform support, excluding tools marked only as any-store. Includes source links and oldest available last checked dates.
